strings.setting.persistence: Panel visibility, VSync and layout are saved automatically and on exit. A previous save is kept as Workspace.json.bak.
strings.setting.retry: Automatic saving is disabled. Save Workspace retries explicitly; Reload Workspace keeps current changes if loading fails.
strings.scene.preview: The central area shows the current render preview.
strings.scene.scope: Scene editing and model import are not available yet.
strings.workspace.docking: Drag panel title bars to arrange the workspace. Use View to reopen panels.
strings.assets.limit: Showing the first 512 entries; open a smaller folder to see more.
strings.inspector.file_scope: File information only. Importing and editing assets are not available yet.
strings.status.load_failed: Workspace load failed; automatic saving is disabled
strings.status.save_failed: Workspace save failed; automatic saving is disabled
